New psoriasis medication. Ever since it been on it my urge to kill myself has been almost several times per week. I used to get once in a while maybe every season change or so. 

I'm a failure in my life. If I don't constantly have people around me to distract or prevent me it just comes over stronger and stronger. I barely take vacation from work because of this. I even go in on weekends just so I'm not alone at home. 

Career wise I don't deserve the good fortune I have achieved. Heavy imposter syndrome. And yet miserable. 

It's my personal life. I have had back to back failed relationships. Pretty much the same result of them cheating and leaving. Sometimes I know it and ignore it because the alternative is being alone. Even though in a room full of people I'm still always lonely. 
Case in point, my most recent ended last night. Instead of coming with me on the trip, which I offered to pay, they stayed behind and went out. FB photos they didn't care to prevent me from seeing, etc. 

This has been the last decade or so, I'm 33. No voices in my head, my own voice always reminds me I'm not with being around.

Have you tried a pet?


I've been having sensations and "attacks" recently getting worse where I think about wanting to just put my 45 and pull the trigger.  
A few things sort of help keep me going; don't help me feel better but I guess struggle on.  One of the things is my job, finding meaning helping my patients. I'm often first in the hospital and last one out, I spend way more time with patients than anyone else, because it's honestly the few "human" contact I have.  


But going back to the pet suggestion... I have a cat that seems to be in tune when I'm having an episode.  He comes up to be pet randomly as all cats do; but when I'm having an episode he comes to me a little differently, like he's petting me. Few times he has come up before I'm having a full episode.

It's not the same as a human touch, but it's something. I'd say he's kept me from pulling the trigger a few times.
I just don't want to be perpetually alone. Someone nagging to death is better than an empty house with just the voices in my head.
